# Qualitative agent: repeat-run variability

**Research output, not financial advice.** Generated by `scripts/qualitative_variability.py` on 2026-10-09 (live, free tier). Not reproducible offline: it measures what the API returns when the same request is sent again. The recorded run is the one in `docs/qualitative_report.md`; the extra runs use the same prompts, rubric and temperature 0, with the response store bypassed so every call is a fresh request.

## Calls and tokens per run

| Run | Model calls | Input tokens | Output tokens | Notional cost | Actual cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| recorded | 35 | 93,801 | 4,691 | $0.0305 | $0.0000 |
| run 1 | 35 | 93,801 | 4,691 | $0.0305 | $0.0000 |
| run 2 | 35 | 93,801 | 4,691 | $0.0305 | $0.0000 |

Token counts are identical in every run, so the API returned the same replies to the same requests: at temperature 0 this model is reproducible for identical prompts. That is not the same as stable under changes: the earlier prompt revisions moved several verdicts (`docs/evaluation_notes.md` item 11), so the labels depend on prompt wording and rubric text more than on API noise.
